changes.text: Seller verification tiers launched — Standard, Verified, and Elite
Seller payout schedule moved from monthly to weekly
Seller onboarding checklist and listing quality guidelines
New genre tags: Simulation, Tactics, Visual Novel
Filter UI redesigned with collapsible sections
Genre filter counts not matching actual result counts
Crypto payments (BTC, ETH) added as an experimental checkout option
Payment method selector reorganized by popularity per region
Checkout crash on Safari iOS when applying a promo code
Cart badge count desyncing after removing an item
Order confirmation email occasionally delayed by up to 20 minutes
EU-West region expansion — regional pricing and VAT-inclusive checkout
SEPA bank transfer added as a payment method
Mobile app checkout flow polish — fewer taps to complete purchase
Verified Seller badge requirements tightened — ID verification now required
Seller application review time reduced from 5 days to 2
Verification badge not displaying on mobile listing cards
Guest checkout — no account required for single-key purchases
Saved payment methods for returning buyers
One-click reorder from order history
Device fingerprinting on checkout to catch repeat chargeback sources
Listing anomaly detection flags sellers with abnormal price or volume spikes for manual review
Stolen-card velocity limits tightened after regional fraud spike
False-positive fraud holds on legitimate bulk gift purchases
AP-Southeast region launch — localized pricing and regional payment rails
Checkout latency improvements for APAC traffic via regional edge routing
Region selector now auto-detects based on billing address
New genre filters: Roguelike, Deckbuilder, Metroidvania, Survival-Crafting
Catalog search now matches on genre tags in addition to title
Filter panel remembers your last selection between visits
Cart drawer overlapping nav bar on iPhone SE and other narrow viewports
Checkout stepper progress indicator not updating on Android Chrome
Catalog grid now reflows to 2 columns below 480px instead of 1
Seller dashboard charts unreadable on mobile — added horizontal scroll
Apple Pay and Google Pay added at checkout
New Elite Seller verification tier with expedited payout and priority catalog placement
Checkout redesigned into a single-page flow — average checkout time down from 74s to 41s
Fraud velocity checks now run before payment capture, not after
Guest checkout occasionally losing cart contents on payment redirect
